topic: From Circles to Heat: Understanding Fourier Series

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Epicycle Intuition
lecture_lines: Periodic motion combines simple circular rotations.
Each circle moves at a unique frequency.
Multiple circles trace out complex shapes.
animations: #FF00FF: Draw a complex periodic path on the background.
#00FFFF: Fade in a single circle with a rotating vector.
#00FF00: Add a second, smaller circle atop the first.
#FFFF00: Add a third, even smaller circle to the chain.
#FFFFFF: The resulting point traces the initial complex path.

sections.title: Fourier Series: Decomposing Complexity
lecture_lines: Periodic signals decompose into sine waves.
Harmonics create a signal's unique timbre.
More harmonics sharpen the signal's edges.
animations: #FF00FF: Display a smooth sine wave on the screen.
#00FF00: Add a third, even higher frequency wave component.
#FFFF00: Sum these waves to show a square wave shape.
#FFFFFF: Highlight the sharp corners of the emerging square wave.

sections.title: Connecting to the Heat Equation
lecture_lines: Heat diffusion is inherently a smooth process.
Higher frequencies dissipate heat much faster.
Fourier series model these different decay rates.
animations: #FF00FF: Display a sharp-edged temperature distribution on a rod.
#00FFFF: Show the temperature gradient at the spike.
#00FF00: Illustrate heat diffusing and the spike lowering.

sections.title: Synthesis: The Circular Perspective
lecture_lines: Heat evolution damps our circular vector components.
High frequencies collapse to center quickly.
Thermal equilibrium corresponds to zero energy.
animations: #FF00FF: Draw circular vectors representing heat frequencies.
#00FFFF: Simulate time-evolution causing high frequencies to shrink.
#00FF00: Observe the distribution flattening toward equilibrium.

sections.title: Conclusion and Application
lecture_lines: Fourier analysis simplifies complex differential equations.
Algebraic tools solve oscillation and dissipation problems.
Technology utilizes these principles for signal processing.
animations: #FF00FF: Display a signal with unwanted noise components.
#00FFFF: Use Fourier decomposition to isolate the noise.
#00FF00: Visualize noise cancellation leaving a clean signal.
